entities.name: Ezekiel the Tragedian
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ezekiel the Tragedian was an Egyptian actor who wrote in Alexandria. Naomi Yavneh dated his work to the 3rd century BCE, while Howard Jacobson estimates the 2nd century BCE. Evidence of the date is not definitive.
